title: The Rockefeller Files
author: Gary Allen
description: Gary Allen presents a polemical account of the Rockefeller family's influence on business and politics. The work offers an example of conspiratorial political writing, inviting scrutiny of its evidence, interpretations and assumptions about power.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
